_doc: A bottle of the game's own booze (#1222, docs/briefs/booze.md): a square amber bitters bottle, a short neck, its paper label on the front panel, a cork. Its labels the brands of its shape (Dr. A. Quill'S, Gen. Corlew'S, Dr. Pruett'S, Mrs. Haskett'S, Cardell'S, Amazon, Dr. Bottoms', Aunt Fanny'S): the Nth made wears label N mod 8 (`variants`), or the one its dressing entry names (`variant`; tools/props/booze.py variant_of). A prop that shatters (GlassProp): a fall onto boards at 4.4 m/s or 60 kPa breaks it and what's in it goes on the floor. Drawn from glb:booze_bottles (tools/blender/props/booze.py): the glass the kit's `glass:` look, every label printed on one sheet (pbr:booze_labels), cork and contents baked the gun way. Written by tools/props/booze.py.
